message.content: Based on the information provided, Niamh suggests that if Jaime had stayed true to the lessons he learned from Brienne of Tarth, he could have ended up being a true protector of the realm. Specifically, Niamh proposes a scenario where Jaime could have chosen to step away from Cersei completely, which would have showcased his growth more effectively. In this scenario, Niamh believes Jaime would have been able to honor his newfound values and duties without falling back into the toxic patterns that led to his earlier choices. This proposal highlights Niamh's belief in the possibility of a more fulfilling and less tragic ending for Jaime, emphasizing the importance of staying true to personal growth and integrity.
